text_description: Full-length runway look built in crisp layered proportions: a black fitted high turtleneck forms the base at the neck, worn under a white collared shirt with pointed collar tips visible above the sweater and oversized white cuffs projecting below the sleeves. Over the shirt is a loose brown open-knit V-neck sweater with a soft, slightly sheer texture, short slouchy sleeves, and an argyle-style front pattern in beige and darker brown diamonds centered across the chest. The waist is sharply defined by a narrow dark belt with a prominent oval silver-toned buckle, sitting over a high-waisted dark chocolate-brown leather skirt. The skirt is long and structured-fluid, falling to the lower calf/ankle in a broad A-line shape, with a glossy surface, vertical paneling, a visible front overlap or wrap-like panel, and subtle horizontal seam lines near the lower portion. Long black leather gloves with pronounced ruching extend up the forearms and are styled over the shirt cuffs, adding a sleek, protective finish. Footwear is visible beneath the skirt as black pointed or softly scrunched boots. The palette is controlled and autumnal—black, white, taupe, beige, and deep brown—with a refined mix of crisp shirting, textured knit, polished leather, and elongated glove styling.
key_elements: white pointed-collar shirt with oversized cuffs
narrow belt with oval silver-toned buckle
high-waisted dark brown leather A-line skirt
uncertainty_notes: The skirt front appears wrap-like, but the exact closure construction is not visible.
The knit reads slightly sheer/open from the image, but fiber content cannot be determined.
